result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: restaurant cards are cut off in the horizontal scroll view, and content is truncated at the page edges, preventing users from viewing complete information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel/scroll container to properly display all cards, either by increasing container width, adjusting card spacing, or implementing proper scroll indicators

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated and is cut off mid-word, likely should be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar
issues.suggestion: Ensure text has proper space to display fully, implement text truncation with ellipsis (...) if needed, or adjust the card layout to accommodate longer restaurant names

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section is partially hidden/cut off, preventing users from seeing the complete card and its details
issues.suggestion: Adjust bottom padding or container height to ensure all cards are fully visible without being cut off at the page bottom
